scenes.title: £1,825 vs £1,633 a month: new vs established 2-bed Airbnbs in Jamaica
scenes.vo: New two-bed Airbnbs in Jamaica price as if they'll gross eighteen hundred and twenty-five pounds a month. Hosts with fifty-plus reviews charge rates worth about sixteen hundred and thirty-three.

scenes.desc: Median nightly rate, 2-bed Airbnbs with no reviews yet (about $134 US)
scenes.vo: That's from a typical rate of a hundred pounds a night, about a hundred and thirty-four US dollars, across six hundred new listings.

scenes.desc: Median nightly rate, 2-beds with 50+ reviews (about $120 US). 10–49 reviews: £85
scenes.vo: Established hosts charge closer to ninety pounds, and those with ten to forty-nine reviews about eighty-five.
So plan on what established hosts charge, not new listings' asking rates. And it's gross, before costs.
Run your own numbers free with the APG Deal Analyser, in pounds, US dollars or Jamaican dollars. Link in my bio.
